code: sim_register_block_type("deadband_abs", category = "user",   description = "max(|u| - width, 0)",   params = list(width = 0.5),   build = function(p) {     w <- p$width     list(inputs = NA, outputs = NA, feedthrough = TRUE,          size_out = function(n) n,          output = function(t, x, d, u) pmax(abs(u[[1]]) - w, 0))   })  m <- sim_model("custom") sim_add_block(m, "sine", "s", amplitude = 2) sim_add_block(m, "deadband_abs", "db", width = 1) sim_connect(m, "s", "db") plot(sim_run(sim_compile(m), c(0, 10)), c("s", "db"))

title: Writing custom blocks
text: first-order low-pass filter time constant \tau, \tau\dot x = u - x, y = x. output read input, feedthrough: lowpass feedthrough, can close feedback loop .
code: sim_register_block_type("lowpass", category = "user",   params = list(tau = 1, initial = 0),   build = function(p) {     tau <- p$tau     if (!is.numeric(tau) || length(tau) != 1L || tau <= 0) stop("`tau` must be positive.")     list(inputs = 1, outputs = 1, feedthrough = FALSE,          nx = 1, x0 = p$initial,          output = function(t, x, d, u) x,          deriv = function(t, x, d, u) (u[[1]] - x) / tau)   })  f <- sim_model("filter") sim_add_block(f, "step", "u", time = 0) sim_add_block(f, "lowpass", "lp", tau = 0.5) sim_connect(f, "u", "lp") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(f), c(0, 3), times = 3, rtol = 1e-10, atol = 1e-12) c(simulated = sim_signal(r, "lp"), exact = 1 - exp(-3 / 0.5)) #> simulated.lp        exact  #>    0.9975212    0.9975212

title: Block ports and signals
text: Elementwise blocks (sum, product, minmax, logic, switch) accept inputs equal size scalars. scalar input expanded common size. implicit size rule. R’s usual recycling length 2 vector length 3 vector refused: fixed-size input fed signal another size also refused:
code: m <- sim_model("recycling") sim_add_block(m, "constant", "a", value = c(1, 2)) sim_add_block(m, "constant", "b", value = c(1, 2, 3)) sim_add_block(m, "sum", "s") sim_connect(m, "a", "s", input = 1) sim_connect(m, "b", "s", input = 2) sim_compile(m) #> Error: #> ! Block 's' (sum): input sizes 2, 3 are incompatible; inputs must have equal sizes or be scalars. m <- sim_model("mismatch") sim_add_block(m, "constant", "a", value = c(1, 2)) sim_add_block(m, "gain", "K", gain = matrix(1, 2, 3)) sim_connect(m, "a", "K") sim_compile(m) #> Error: #> ! Signal size mismatch: 'a' output 1 has size 2 but input 'in1' of block 'K' expects size 3.

title: Building your first block diagram
text: want simulate \frac{dx}{dt} = r - x, \qquad r = 1, \qquad x(0) = 0, whose exact solution x(t) = 1 - e^{-t}. block diagram constant reference r, sum block computing error r - x, integrator whose input error whose output x. output integrator fed back sum.

what: Step 1: create a model and add blocks
title: Building your first block diagram
text: model container. sim_add_block() adds block registered type unique name parameters, returns handle. sum block one input port per sign, signs = c("+", "-") (string "+-") gives two inputs computes in1 - in2. Models modified place: need reassign model.
code: model <- sim_model("feedback_system")  reference <- sim_add_block(model, type = "constant", name = "reference", value = 1) error <- sim_add_block(model, type = "sum", name = "error", signs = c("+", "-")) plant <- sim_add_block(model, type = "integrator", name = "plant", initial = 0)

title: Building your first block diagram
text: sim_connect() wires output port one block input port another. Ports numbered 1; default port 1. Connections checked immediately possible: connecting port exist, connecting two sources input, error.
code: sim_connect(model, from = reference, to = error, input = 1) sim_connect(model, from = plant, to = error, input = 2) sim_connect(model, from = error, to = plant) model #> <sim_model 'feedback_system'> 3 block(s), 3 connection(s), 0 event(s) #>   reference [constant] #>   error [sum] #>   plant [integrator] #> Connections: #>   reference:1 -> error:1 #>   plant:1 -> error:2 #>   error:1 -> plant:1 sim_connect(model, from = reference, to = error, input = 3) #> Error: #> ! Block 'error' has 2 input port(s); port 3 does not exist. sim_connect(model, from = reference, to = plant) #> Error: #> ! Input 1 of block 'plant' is already connected to 'error' output 1. Disconnect it first with sim_disconnect().

title: Building your first block diagram
text: Compilation validates whole diagram produces immutable execution plan. Notice execution order: plant comes error, even though added later. integrator’s output depends state, input instant (direct feedthrough), can evaluated first. sum direct feedthrough, must wait inputs. feedback loop therefore valid: passes stateful block. See vignette("compilation") details.
code: plan <- sim_compile(model) plan #> <sim_plan 'feedback_system'> 3 block(s), 1 continuous state(s), 0 discrete state(s), 3 signal element(s) #> Execution order: plant > reference > error

title: Building your first block diagram
text: times output times. independent internal steps adaptive solver takes.
code: result <- sim_run(plan, tspan = c(0, 10), times = seq(0, 10, by = 0.01)) result #> <sim_result 'feedback_system'> status: success #>   1001 recorded time(s) in [0, 10] #>   3 signal element(s), 1 continuous and 0 discrete state(s), 0 event(s)

title: State machines
text: every sample hit block: collects transitions leaving active state, sorted priority (smaller first) position list; fires first one whose guard true whose time (time spent active state) elapsed; runs, order, exit action old state, transition action entry action new state, records entry time; transition fires, runs action active state. one transition fires per hit, evaluation always terminates, ordering never depends R list iteration details. Outputs computed transition: outputs hit reflect inputs hit. Guards actions strings (portable, checked whitelist) R functions. Guards see u (input vector), t, elapsed data variables; actions assign data variables.

title: State machines
text: output ports state (index active state), y (per-state outputs, given) data (data variables).
code: m <- sim_model("traffic") sim_add_block(m, "constant", "enable", value = 1) sim_add_block(m, "state_machine", "light", period = 1,   states = c("red", "green", "yellow"),   transitions = list(     sim_transition("red", "green", after = 3),     sim_transition("green", "yellow", after = 2),     sim_transition("yellow", "red", after = 1)),   outputs = list(red = 1, green = 2, yellow = 3)) sim_connect(m, "enable", "light") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(m), c(0, 12), times = 0:12) data.frame(t = sim_times(r), state = c("red", "green", "yellow")[sim_signal(r, "light.state")]) #>     t  state #> 1   0    red #> 2   1    red #> 3   2    red #> 4   3  green #> 5   4  green #> 6   5 yellow #> 7   6    red #> 8   7    red #> 9   8    red #> 10  9  green #> 11 10  green #> 12 11 yellow #> 13 12    red

title: State machines
text: counter many times machine re-entered state : entry action initial state runs , first hit, inputs time hit, transition tried.
code: m <- sim_model("counter") sim_add_block(m, "time", "t") sim_add_block(m, "state_machine", "sm", period = 1,   states = c("a", "b"),   transitions = list(     sim_transition("a", "b", "u[1] >= 2", action = "n <- n + 10"),     sim_transition("b", "a", "TRUE")),   entry = list(a = "n <- n + 1"),   data = c(n = 0)) sim_connect(m, "t", "sm") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(m), c(0, 6), times = 0:6) cbind(t = sim_times(r), state = sim_signal(r, "sm.state"), n = sim_signal(r, "sm.data")) #>      t state  n #> [1,] 0     1  1 #> [2,] 1     1  1 #> [3,] 2     2 11 #> [4,] 3     1 12 #> [5,] 4     2 22 #> [6,] 5     1 23 #> [7,] 6     2 33

title: State machines
text: heater controlled two-state machine hysteresis. room cools toward 10 degrees heater adds 2 degrees per unit time.  machine samples every 0.1 time units, temperature overshoots thresholds slightly; expected behavior sampled controller.
code: th <- sim_model("thermostat") sim_add_block(th, "integrator", "temp", initial = 18) sim_add_block(th, "state_machine", "ctrl", period = 0.1,   states = c("heating", "idle"),   transitions = list(     sim_transition("heating", "idle", "u[1] > 21"),     sim_transition("idle", "heating", "u[1] < 19")),   outputs = list(heating = 1, idle = 0)) sim_add_block(th, "mux", "mx") sim_add_block(th, "expression", "rate", expr = "2 * u[1] - 0.1 * (u[2] - 10)") sim_connect(th, "temp", "ctrl") sim_connect(th, "ctrl", "mx", output = "y", input = 1) sim_connect(th, "temp", "mx", input = 2) sim_connect(th, "mx", "rate") sim_connect(th, "rate", "temp") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(th), c(0, 30)) plot(r, c("temp", "ctrl.y"))

title: State machines
text: sim_check_state_machine() reports unreachable states (ignoring guards) states without outgoing transitions, errors unknown states ambiguous priorities. block runs structural checks built. Formal verification state machine properties (example sibling package ‘z3r’) planned, part release.
code: sim_check_state_machine(c("off", "on", "fault"),   list(sim_transition("off", "on", "u[1] > 0"),        sim_transition("on", "off", "u[1] <= 0")),   initial = "off") #> $unreachable #> [1] "fault" #>  #> $absorbing #> [1] "fault" sim_check_state_machine(c("a", "b"),   list(sim_transition("a", "b", priority = 1),        sim_transition("a", "a", priority = 1))) #> Error: #> ! State 'a' has transitions with the same priority; the order would be ambiguous.

title: Hierarchical subsystems
text: actuator saturates command \pm 1, applies gain responds first-order lag \frac{1}{s + 1}: index sets port number inport outport. Indices must 1, 2, … without gaps.
code: actuator <- sim_subsystem("actuator", params = list(gain = 1)) sim_add_block(actuator, "inport", "command", index = 1) sim_add_block(actuator, "saturation", "sat", lower = -1, upper = 1) sim_add_block(actuator, "gain", "k", gain = sim_param("gain")) sim_add_block(actuator, "transfer_function", "lag", num = 1, den = c(1, 1)) sim_add_block(actuator, "outport", "force", index = 1) sim_connect(actuator, "command", "sat") sim_connect(actuator, "sat", "k") sim_connect(actuator, "k", "lag") sim_connect(actuator, "lag", "force")

title: Hierarchical subsystems
text: compilation instance’s blocks named instance/block. instance name refers output, inner signals remain available:
code: m <- sim_model("two_actuators") sim_add_block(m, "sine", "cmd", amplitude = 2, frequency = 1) sim_add_block(m, "subsystem", "weak", system = actuator, params = list(gain = 0.5)) sim_add_block(m, "subsystem", "strong", system = actuator, params = list(gain = 3)) sim_connect(m, "cmd", "weak") sim_connect(m, "cmd", "strong") plan <- sim_compile(m) plan$diagnostics$order #>  [1] "cmd"            "strong/command" "strong/lag"     "strong/force"   #>  [5] "strong/sat"     "strong/k"       "weak/command"   "weak/lag"       #>  [9] "weak/force"     "weak/sat"       "weak/k" r <- sim_run(plan, c(0, 10)) plot(r, c("cmd", "weak", "strong")) head(sim_signal(r, c("weak", "strong/sat")), 3) #>             weak strong/sat #> [1,] 0.000000000 0.00000000 #> [2,] 0.001229168 0.09995834 #> [3,] 0.004833336 0.19966683 colnames(sim_states(r)) #> [1] "strong/lag" "weak/lag"

title: Hierarchical subsystems
text: sim_param("name") inside subsystem resolved order: instance’s params; subsystem’s default params; enclosing model (enclosing subsystem instance), top-level model. Instance parameters may refer parent’s parameters, makes possible drive many components one top-level value:
code: top <- sim_model("shared", params = list(G = 2)) sim_add_block(top, "constant", "u", value = 0.4) sim_add_block(top, "subsystem", "a1", system = actuator,               params = list(gain = sim_param("G"))) sim_connect(top, "u", "a1") p <- sim_compile(top) sim_signal(sim_run(p, c(0, 20), times = 20), "a1") #>  a1  #> 0.8 sim_signal(sim_run(sim_set_params(p, G = 5), c(0, 20), times = 20), "a1") #> a1  #>  2

title: Hierarchical subsystems
text: instance gets copy inner blocks, instances never share state. Changing initial state one affect :
code: r <- sim_run(plan, c(0, 1), times = 1, initial = list(`weak/lag` = 1)) sim_signal(r, c("weak", "strong")) #>      weak    strong  #> 0.6276589 1.5586739

title: Hierarchical subsystems
text: Subsystems can contain subsystems. Two actuators series inside “drive train”:
code: train <- sim_subsystem("train") sim_add_block(train, "inport", "in", index = 1) sim_add_block(train, "subsystem", "first", system = actuator) sim_add_block(train, "subsystem", "second", system = actuator) sim_add_block(train, "outport", "out", index = 1) sim_connect(train, "in", "first") sim_connect(train, "first", "second") sim_connect(train, "second", "out") outer <- sim_model("vehicle") sim_add_block(outer, "step", "u", time = 0, after = 0.5) sim_add_block(outer, "subsystem", "drive", system = train) sim_connect(outer, "u", "drive") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(outer), c(0, 5), times = 5, rtol = 1e-10, atol = 1e-12) # two unit lags in series: 1 - (1 + t) exp(-t), scaled by 0.5 c(simulated = sim_signal(r, "drive"), exact = 0.5 * (1 - 6 * exp(-5))) #> simulated.drive           exact  #>       0.4797862       0.4797862

title: Validation against exact solutions
code: m <- sim_model("decay") sim_add_block(m, "integrator", "x", initial = 1) sim_add_block(m, "gain", "k", gain = -1.5) sim_connect(m, "x", "k") sim_connect(m, "k", "x") r <- tight(sim_compile(m), c(0, 4), times = seq(0, 4, 0.1)) checks$decay <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "x") - exp(-1.5 * sim_times(r))))

title: Validation against exact solutions
text: \ddot q = -\omega^2 q, q(0) = 1, q(t) = \cos \omega t.
code: o <- sim_model("osc") sim_add_block(o, "integrator", "q", initial = 1) sim_add_block(o, "integrator", "v", initial = 0) sim_add_block(o, "gain", "k", gain = -9) sim_connect(o, "v", "q") sim_connect(o, "q", "k") sim_connect(o, "k", "v") r <- tight(sim_compile(o), c(0, 10), times = seq(0, 10, 0.05)) checks$oscillator <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "q") - cos(3 * sim_times(r))))

what: Linear system and the matrix exponential
title: Validation against exact solutions
code: A <- matrix(c(-1, 2, -2, -1), 2, 2) s <- sim_model("linear") sim_add_block(s, "constant", "u", value = 0) sim_add_block(s, "state_space", "g", A = A, B = matrix(0, 2, 1), C = diag(2),               initial = c(1, 0)) sim_connect(s, "u", "g") r <- tight(sim_compile(s), c(0, 3), times = c(1, 2, 3)) # exp(A t) for A = [[-1, -2], [2, -1]] is exp(-t) * rotation(2 t) ex <- t(sapply(c(1, 2, 3), function(t) exp(-t) * c(cos(2 * t), sin(2 * t)))) checks$state_space <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "g") - ex))

title: Validation against exact solutions
text: G(s) = \frac{\omega^2}{s^2 + 2\zeta\omega s + \omega^2} \zeta = 0.3, \omega = 2.
code: z <- 0.3; w <- 2; wd <- w * sqrt(1 - z^2) tf <- sim_model("tf") sim_add_block(tf, "step", "u", time = 0) sim_add_block(tf, "transfer_function", "G", num = w^2, den = c(1, 2 * z * w, w^2)) sim_connect(tf, "u", "G") r <- tight(sim_compile(tf), c(0, 10), times = seq(0, 10, 0.05)) tt <- sim_times(r) exact <- 1 - exp(-z * w * tt) * (cos(wd * tt) + z * w / wd * sin(wd * tt)) checks$second_order <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "G") - exact))

title: Validation against exact solutions
code: d <- sim_model("recurrence") sim_add_block(d, "constant", "u", value = 1) sim_add_block(d, "discrete_state_space", "x", A = 0.9, B = 0.5, C = 1,               initial = 0, period = 0.5) sim_connect(d, "u", "x") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(d), c(0, 10), times = seq(0, 10, 0.5)) ref <- Reduce(function(x, k) 0.9 * x + 0.5, 1:20, accumulate = TRUE, 0) checks$recurrence <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "x") - ref))

title: Validation against exact solutions
code: Ts <- 0.25; K <- 1.5 sc <- sim_model("sampled") sim_add_block(sc, "constant", "ref", value = 1) sim_add_block(sc, "zero_order_hold", "y_k", period = Ts) sim_add_block(sc, "subtract", "e") sim_add_block(sc, "gain", "K", gain = K) sim_add_block(sc, "zero_order_hold", "u_k", period = Ts) sim_add_block(sc, "subtract", "rhs") sim_add_block(sc, "integrator", "x") sim_connect(sc, "x", "y_k") sim_connect(sc, "ref", "e", input = 1) sim_connect(sc, "y_k", "e", input = 2) sim_connect(sc, "e", "K") sim_connect(sc, "K", "u_k") sim_connect(sc, "u_k", "rhs", input = 1) sim_connect(sc, "x", "rhs", input = 2) sim_connect(sc, "rhs", "x") r <- tight(sim_compile(sc), c(0, 5), times = Ts * 0:20) phi <- exp(-Ts) ref <- Reduce(function(x, k) phi * x + (1 - phi) * K * (1 - x), 1:20, accumulate = TRUE, 0) checks$sampled_control <- max(abs(sim_signal(r, "x") - ref))

title: Validation against exact solutions
code: b <- sim_model("ball") sim_add_block(b, "constant", "g", value = -9.81) sim_add_block(b, "integrator", "v") sim_add_block(b, "integrator", "h", initial = 1) sim_connect(b, "g", "v") sim_connect(b, "v", "h") sim_add_event(b, "impact", sim_zero_crossing("h", direction = "falling"),               reset = list(v = "-0.7 * x")) r <- tight(sim_compile(b), c(0, 2)) t1 <- sqrt(2 / 9.81); v <- 0.7 * 9.81 * t1; ref <- t1 for (i in 1:3) { ref <- c(ref, tail(ref, 1) + 2 * v / 9.81); v <- 0.7 * v } checks$impacts <- max(abs(sim_events(r)$time[1:4] - ref))

title: Compile a model into an execution plan — sim_compile
text: Flatten subsystems resolve sim_param() references. Build every block validate parameters. Validate connections: blocks ports exist every input exactly one source. Propagate signal sizes along connections check compatibility. Build direct-feedthrough dependency graph. edge block block B output feeds input B direct feedthrough. Inputs integrators, unit delays state-output blocks create edge, feedback valid. Find strongly connected components graph. component one block, block feeding , algebraic loop. Order blocks topologically. Ties broken block name, order, state vector layout results depend order blocks connections added. Lay signal, continuous state discrete state vectors collect sample times, zero-crossing functions events. Algebraic loops rejected default. algebraic_loops = "solve" loop solved every evaluation Newton iterations loop outputs, finite-difference Jacobian backtracking; run fails error residual fall loop_tol.

title: Compile a model into an execution plan — sim_compile
code: m <- sim_model("feedback") sim_add_block(m, "constant", "r", value = 1) sim_add_block(m, "subtract", "e") sim_add_block(m, "integrator", "x") sim_connect(m, "r", "e", input = 1) sim_connect(m, "x", "e", input = 2) sim_connect(m, "e", "x") plan <- sim_compile(m) plan #> <sim_plan 'feedback'> 3 block(s), 1 continuous state(s), 0 discrete state(s), 3 signal element(s) #> Execution order: r > x > e sim_diagnostics(plan)$order #> [1] "r" "x" "e"  # A loop of direct-feedthrough blocks is an algebraic loop. m2 <- sim_model("loop") sim_add_block(m2, "constant", "u", value = 1) sim_add_block(m2, "sum", "s", signs = "+-") sim_add_block(m2, "gain", "k", gain = 2) sim_connect(m2, "u", "s", input = 1) sim_connect(m2, "k", "s", input = 2) sim_connect(m2, "s", "k") try(sim_compile(m2)) #> Error : Algebraic loop(s) detected: every block on the cycle has direct feedthrough, so the outputs depend on themselves at the same time. #>   k -> s -> k #> Break the loop with a stateful block (integrator, unit_delay, ...) or compile with algebraic_loops = "solve". plan2 <- sim_compile(m2, algebraic_loops = "solve") sim_signal(sim_run(plan2, c(0, 1), times = 1), "s") # y = 1 - 2y, so 1/3 #>         s  #> 0.3333333

code: # A thermostat that heats below 19 degrees and stops above 21. m <- sim_model("thermostat") sim_add_block(m, "integrator", "temp", initial = 18) sim_add_block(m, "state_machine", "ctrl", period = 0.1,   states = c("heating", "idle"),   transitions = list(     sim_transition("heating", "idle", "u[1] > 21"),     sim_transition("idle", "heating", "u[1] < 19")),   outputs = list(heating = 1, idle = 0)) sim_add_block(m, "expression", "rate", expr = "2 * u[1] - 0.1 * (u[2] - 10)") sim_add_block(m, "mux", "mx") sim_connect(m, "temp", "ctrl") sim_connect(m, "ctrl", "mx", output = "y", input = 1) sim_connect(m, "temp", "mx", input = 2) sim_connect(m, "mx", "rate") sim_connect(m, "rate", "temp") r <- sim_run(sim_compile(m), c(0, 10)) range(sim_signal(r, "temp")) #> [1] 18.00000 21.02948
